annotations.text:
ClearDisk app screens, left to right: first launch and permission, then the System Data breakdown (the hero screen), categories, treemap, and the cleaning confirmation.
Direction: Apple-native polish - trust-first for a non-technical audience.

cleardisk.app landing page. Hero targets "clear system data on mac".
Testimonial and support email are placeholders - fill after launch.

Alternate direction: a friendlier, warmer take on the main screen.
Prefer this vibe? Say so and the whole set gets restyled.
